project.name: Fleet Management System
project.description: Centralize fleet operations and maintenance tracking.

requirements.name: Record vehicle mileage
requirements.description: Driver logs current mileage against a vehicle record.

requirements.name: Surface maintenance due status
requirements.description: System flags a vehicle as due for service once its configured interval is reached.

business_rules.description: Preventive maintenance becomes due after the configured mileage interval or date interval, whichever occurs first.

open_questions.description: Should the system notify someone when a vehicle becomes due, or is a dashboard sufficient for v1?
